stories.headline: New Zealand's Operation Magpie nets cocaine, MDMA, ketamine and 70 kg of pseudoephedrine, with four men remanded
stories.body: Canterbury organised-crime detectives and Customs announced on 7 November that several border consignments had been intercepted and warrants executed across Canterbury. Seizures included 10 kg of cocaine, 24.5 kg of MDMA, 10.6 kg of ketamine, 70 kg of pseudoephedrine, thousands of ecstasy and LSD tablets, a 3D-printed firearm, pill-press equipment and more than $500,000 in cash. Four men aged 27 to 35 were remanded in custody ahead of a Christchurch District Court appearance.
